To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Iranian EFL students: (a) have a low regard for writing and hold grammar in high regard; (b) prefer direct and teacher explicit WCF; (c) prefer selective correction and peer feedback; and (d) are more likely to engage with WCF if the practices are in line with their perceptions and preferences.
Iranian EFL students’ affective dispositions towards WCF are profoundly affected by their first language (L) identities.
